definitions.geometry: Existing frozen native STEP samples: bidirectional squared Chamfer; no GT used for repair or choice.
definitions.tolerance: Maximum stored OCC face/edge/vertex tolerance from native STEP read; not a measured geometric error.
definitions.boundary: Counts/no-skipped-wire checks only. They do not prove per-loop correspondence, hole shape or continuous accuracy.
definitions.wire_comparison: Sorted wires-per-face and additional wires beyond one per face; no face correspondence assumed. Extra wires do not alone certify holes. The two flagged cases were inspected separately: see wire_structure_followup; neither is explained by the periodic natural-loop exception.
definitions.rescue: B0 native_valid_solid false and B2 native_valid_solid true, with all planned IDs retained.

wire_structure_followup.observed: Two rescued cases have wire-count differences on nonperiodic planar faces; the assembled wire list already has one wire before trimming. Known periodic natural-loop conversion does not explain these differences.
wire_structure_followup.limit: No claim is made that a particular physical hole was filled. Wire counts alone are insufficient, and the original baseline also has the same counts.
